name: metpy-reusable-vertical-transformation-plans
instr:
MetPy cannot reuse transformation plans while preserving axis and coordinate identity across interpolation, parcel profiles, pressure layers, and turbulence calculations. Calls without plans must retain their results, warnings, exceptions, metadata, shapes, units, masks, and container conventions.

`AxisPlan`, created by `axis_plan(self, axis)`, resolves positional axes, dimension names, and recognized semantic xarray axes. `validate(self, obj)` raises `AxisPlanMismatch`, a `ValueError` with diagnostic attributes, before incompatible dimensions, coordinates, lengths, or broadcasts produce output. `restore(self, values)` reverses working order. Broadcast indexing must preserve the selected axis across rank changes.

`InterpolationPlan.apply(self, *variables, return_list_always=False)` atomically reuses linear or logarithmic mappings, restores target order and duplicates, and preserves bounds, fill, masks, units, shapes, and return containers. Logarithmic plans use original positive coordinates and reject linear plans. Changed source coordinates must invalidate a reused plan before returning mapped variables. Named nonleading axes must survive higher-rank interpolation at decreasing targets.

`ProfilePlan.with_inserted_level(self, level)` keeps original duplicates distinct from derived levels. Parcel operations preserve pressure identity, physical results, vertical dimensions, metadata, and duplicates under descending pressure; increasing pressure still raises `InvalidSoundingE
